r1-obs_payments_errors.question: Analyze error logs, trace data, and metrics for the payments service between 13:55 and 14:30 on 2026-03-10. What specific endpoints or payment providers/gateways are failing, and what are the exact error messages or HTTP response status codes?

finding.summary: Analysis of the payments service between 13:55 and 14:30 shows payment failures resulting in HTTP 500 errors triggered by NullPointerExceptions in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount line 88, causing the service error rate in us-east to jump to ~18-19%.

claims.text: The payments service recorded ERROR logs at 14:03 and 14:04 with the exact error message "NullPointerException in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount line 88".
The checkout service logged an ERROR at 14:05 indicating that requests to payments returned HTTP response status code 500 ("payments returned 500 order=8840").
The error_rate metric for the payments service in us-east rose from ~0.002-0.003 prior to 14:05 up to 0.18-0.19 between 14:05 and 14:15.
The failing payment operations are handling discount calculations in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount, causing HTTP 500 internal server errors returned to calling services like checkout.

gaps: Specific external payment gateway/provider names (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) and explicit endpoint URLs (e.g., /charge) were not logged or present in the available metrics/logs.

hypotheses.statement: Deployment v2.4.0 of the payments service introduced a code defect in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount that throws NullPointerExceptions during card payment processing.
assumptions: The new discount code logic in v2.4.0 (ChargeHandler.applyDiscount) introduced an unhandled null check or uninitialized variable when processing transactions.

hypotheses.statement: Payvendor API responses changed or returned unexpected null values, causing ChargeHandler.applyDiscount to fail with NullPointerExceptions.
assumptions: The third-party payment vendor payvendor returned null or missing fields in API responses, which ChargeHandler.applyDiscount failed to safely parse.

hypotheses.statement: Missing data or database query null results in postgres caused NullPointerExceptions in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount.
assumptions: Postgres returned null records or missing discount code rows, leading to unhandled NullPointerExceptions in payments service.

report.summary: Card payments have been failing at checkout since ~14:05 due to NullPointerExceptions in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount introduced in deployment v2.4.0 of the payments service. The primary cause is high confidence code defect hyp-01. Other potential contributing factors (payvendor API response changes or database query nulls) are considered low confidence.

assumptions: The new discount code logic in v2.4.0 (ChargeHandler.applyDiscount) introduced an unhandled null check or uninitialized variable when processing transactions.

assumptions: The third-party payment vendor payvendor returned null or missing fields in API responses, which ChargeHandler.applyDiscount failed to safely parse.

hypotheses.statement: Missing data or database query null results in postgres caused NullPointerExceptions in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount.
assumptions: Postgres returned null records or missing discount code rows, leading to unhandled NullPointerExceptions in payments service.

The checkout service logged an ERROR at 14:05 indicating that requests to payments returned HTTP response status code 500 ("payments returned 500 order=8840").
The error_rate metric for the payments service in us-east rose from ~0.002-0.003 prior to 14:05 up to 0.18-0.19 between 14:05 and 14:15.
A deployment (v2.4.0: add discount codes to charge flow) was applied to the payments service at 2026-03-10T14:02.
The payments service depends on postgres and payvendor, and is depended on by checkout.

assumptions.text: The new discount code logic in v2.4.0 (ChargeHandler.applyDiscount) introduced an unhandled null check or uninitialized variable when processing transactions.

actions.description: Roll back payments service from deployment v2.4.0 to the previous stable version (v2.3.9) to resolve NullPointerExceptions in ChargeHandler.applyDiscount.
Deploy a fix or patch for ChargeHandler.applyDiscount to safely handle null discount values and add log coverage for external gateway endpoint responses.
